literal_meaning: মনে আটকে যাওয়া বা ধরে রাখা (in the mind to catch or hold)
figurative_meaning_en: to like; to find pleasing or appealing
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বইটা পড়ে আমার খুব মনে ধরেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I have taken a liking to you.
I really liked this book after reading it.
note: This idiom is a staple in colloquial Bengali, often used to express budding affection or appreciation.
